name: starter
description: Minimal hand-curated Q&A pairs for smoke testing the eval pipeline. Replace with corpus-specific pairs once documents are ingested.

samples.expected_answer: This project is a local RAG system with evaluation infrastructure built on DeepEval, designed for iterative improvement.

samples.query: How are documents chunked in this system?
samples.expected_answer: Documents are split using recursive character splitting with document-type-aware separators. Markdown splits on headings, code splits on class and function boundaries, and mermaid diagrams are kept whole when possible.

samples.query: What embedding model is used and why?
samples.expected_answer: The system uses a Nomic embedding model via LM Studio's OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v1.5). It was chosen for its small memory footprint (137M params), 8K token context window, and 768-dimensional embeddings, leaving plenty of VRAM for the generation model.

samples.query: How does the evaluation system work?
samples.expected_answer: The evaluation system uses DeepEval with a local LLM judge served by LM Studio (OpenAI-compatible /v1 API). It measures faithfulness, answer relevancy, contextual precision, and contextual recall. Custom G-Eval metrics can be added for domain-specific evaluation.

samples.query: What vector store does this project use?
samples.expected_answer: The project uses ChromaDB with persistent on-disk storage and cosine similarity search.
